## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies substantial Pali-internal text reuse between the *Morahatthiyattheraapadāna* and traditional exegesis, most extensively with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (particularly segments §0.3–6.1, which match verses in the second volume with high similarity) as well as the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. The poem also shares recurring narrative and metrical segments with other Apadāna texts, including the *Naḷamālikātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 5), the *Yāgudāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 420), the *Ekachattiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 459), and the *Pañcahatthiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 186) [DharmaNexus]. Across language traditions, DharmaNexus calculates machine alignments with the Sanskrit *Kaṭhināvadāna* and the Chinese *Madhyama Āgama* (*Zhong ahan jing*, T 26), reflecting shared formulaic phrases rather than established textual parallels [DharmaNexus].
